title: Child process group cleanup
responsibility: Stops a command’s process group and follows surviving descendants that moved outside the group.

inputs.name: signalGroup.child
inputs.description: Child whose pid identifies the process group to signal. A missing or falsy pid makes group signaling a no-op.

inputs.name: signalGroup.signal
inputs.description: Signal sent to the process group addressed by the negative child pid. Only SIGTERM and SIGKILL are accepted.

inputs.name: groupTeardown.child
inputs.description: Child whose process group receives SIGKILL before descendants are checked. If its pid is missing or falsy, the group signal is skipped.

inputs.name: groupTeardown.descendants
inputs.description: Tracker queried through its survivors() method to obtain remaining descendant processes. It is checked after the group signal and polled at 100 ms intervals while the settling threshold remains.

inputs.name: groupTeardown.timing
inputs.description: Required waits in milliseconds: settleMs is checked between survivor polls spaced 100 ms apart, and graceMs is awaited after SIGTERM before SIGKILL. No defaults are applied.

outputs.name: signalGroup
outputs.description: Returns no value. It skips signaling when child.pid is missing or falsy and suppresses errors from process.kill.

outputs.name: groupTeardown
outputs.description: Resolves with the last survivor list obtained before escalation. If that list is nonempty, the function sends SIGTERM, waits graceMs, sends SIGKILL, and returns the same list without checking again.

errors.name: unknown
errors.description: Rejects with the value thrown or rejected by descendants.survivors() or signalProcesses; this implementation does not assign a specific error name.
